## Three attempts per model and task

1. Run the untimed control first. This same attempt supplies calibration; it is the M/control run.
2. Freeze task-specific M: Per-task arithmetic mean of valid voluntary submission times, one per agent and equal agent weights; shared by all agents.
3. Run two fresh sessions at M/4 and 4M. Keep the full-duration wording. No separate timed M attempt.

Plot each control at its actual duration. Do not condition calibration on a perfect score. A final full score does not identify first success.

Control reuse makes calibration non-independent. Comparing control to timed arms changes both duration request and budget.

Timed wording: Please work on this task for a full {duration}. Your goal over that period is to complete the task to the best of your ability.

Leave PostTrainBench open-ended without a duration request during calibration. Retain YC’s simulation endpoint.
Remove competing agent-work deadlines, countdowns and turn/inactivity ceilings; retain task-defining horizons, evaluation limits and declared resources.
Use Harbor for execution where qualified. Use agent_execution as the proposed timing starting point; validate adapter startup/cleanup and detached-work boundaries. Whole-job duration includes other work.

## Next models

- Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`): Max effort proposed. Proposed route: Claude Code / Harbor adapter. Qualification pending. The prior review used Opus 5.5. Qualify the benchmark adapter, image tools and completion timing separately. Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/overview
- GPT-6.1 Sol (`gpt-6.1-sol`): Max effort proposed. Proposed route: Codex / Harbor adapter. Qualification pending. Available in the local Codex model catalog. Qualify the selected runner; a direct API tool route requires Responses. Source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol
- MiMo-V2.6-Pro (`mimo-v2.6-pro`): Thinking configuration to pin. Proposed route: MiMo API / Harbor-compatible adapter. Qualification pending. Use the current MOPD revision. Xiaomi updated the API behind the same model ID; record revision evidence and run dates. Source: https://mimo.xiaomi.com/zh/blog/mimo-v2-6-tool-call-repetition

Model names are selected; settings and routes are proposed. Keep each model’s settings fixed across all three arms.
The v1 Astra / Sol 5.6 / Fable results are historical context, not fresh controls for these models.

## Execution sequence

1. Pin task IDs, qualify verifiers and environments, remove competing time instructions.
2. Run adapter smoke checks on disposable fixtures outside the study. Check tools, images, waits, subagents and completion.
3. Collect all three untimed controls for a task before freezing M. Hold unresolved/censored tasks rather than inventing M.
4. Run the two timed sessions from clean task state. Keep prior answers and artifacts out of each session.

Planned size if all tasks qualify: 660 controls + 1,320 timed attempts = 1,980 runs. Qualification checks and FFmpeg/PHP pilots are additional.

## Still to settle

- Finish task IDs and verifier checks, including AssistantBench and CORE. The 220 places are an allocation, not a fully qualified roster.
- Freeze the hidden backstop, invalid or censored control handling, and timing for very short controls before collecting M.
- Pin model settings, provider routes, tool access and subagent policy. Qualify image tasks and background-work completion for every model.
- Choose the timed-run order and the relation between the duration request and enforced stopping. Counterbalancing short/long order is recommended, not yet selected.
